comments.body:
I was at EPFL (ETH Lausanne) and from what I know, the systems are very similar.
In my experience, the 28 weeks are not extendable, unless there is a reason (sickness, etc). Are you sure this is normal? Or is it that they work a month after submitting their thesis?
Usually your defense will be within 30 days of handing your thesis. After your defense, the prof can submit the grade. The fact that your friend had to wait 3 months for his grade is not normal. If the deadline is missed because the prof did not hand in your grade, the administration would go after your professor, not you.
I wouldn't worry at all, 4 months is more than enough. I had 3 weeks between thesis submission and the grade handin.
comments.author: thatchemist96
